input.query: list identities filter by attribute email

transcript.text: Let me search for the relevant SailPoint identity lookup tools.
Let me get the full spec for both the search endpoint and the public-identities endpoint.

There are two good approaches depending on how much access you need.

---

## Option A: `POST /v3/search` (recommended — full identity object, any attribute)

This uses the Search API against the `identities` index and supports any attribute, including custom ones.

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/search
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "indices": ["identities"],
  "query": {
    "query": "email:\"jane.doe@example.com\""
  }
}
```

To target a **custom / extended attribute** instead of a top-level field, prefix it with `attributes.`:

```json
{
  "indices": ["identities"],
  "query": {
    "query": "attributes.department:\"Engineering\""
  }
}
```

You can also narrow which fields are returned:

```json
{
  "indices": ["identities"],
  "query": {
    "query": "email:\"jane.doe@example.com\""
  },
  "queryResultFilter": {
    "includes": ["id", "name", "email", "displayName", "attributes"]
  }
}
```

**Required scope:** `sp:search:read`  
**Minimum user level:** `ORG_ADMIN` (or `SOURCE_ADMIN`, `REPORT_ADMIN`, etc.)

---

## Option B: `GET /v3/public-identities` (simpler, but public fields only)

Uses standard V3 filter syntax. Any authenticated user can call this.

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/public-identities
    ?filters=email%20eq%20%22jane.doe@example.com%22
    &add-core-filters=true
Authorization: Bearer {token}
```

Decoded filter: `filters=email eq "jane.doe@example.com"`

**Required scope:** `sp:scopes:default`  
**Minimum user level:** `USER`

This only returns fields configured as "public" in your org's identity profile, so it's best for user-facing lookups (e.g., an access-request UI's people-picker), not admin lookups.

---

## Which to use?

| Need | Use |
|---|---|
| Full identity data, any attribute, admin context | `POST /v3/search` |
| Simple lookup, public fields only, any user | `GET /v3/public-identities` |

---

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/search
    api_version: v3
  - method: GET
    path: /v3/public-identities
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [sp:search:read, sp:scopes:default]
key_parameters: [indices, query, queryResultFilter, filters, add-core-filters]
```
